about: Names of surf spots that OpenStreetMap misspells, corrected by Vigie in app/data/surf-spots.json (tools/build_spots.py). OpenStreetMap is not edited from here. Each correction names the element, the name as OpenStreetMap writes it, the name Vigie gives, and the evidence that the name is misspelt. A correction whose OpenStreetMap name has changed is not applied (the builder says so).

corrections.name: Plage de la Marbella
corrections.evidence: Three l's in OpenStreetMap; the surf club on this beach is named 'Marbella Surf Club' in OpenStreetMap itself (node/14222393485). Read on 2026-10-29.
